SUPERVISOR — bug, USER verbatim: "reset part button does not reset the part." Marker: RESETPART-0606 (resolve the req matching this text).

Data first, three hops: (1) does the button's handler fire (log it), (2) does the underlying draft/grid data actually reset (inspect before/after), (3) does the VIEW refresh after the data resets — note the camera lane just found lens views holding stale state until remount; if reset works at the data layer but the view shows stale, it is the same staleness family — coordinate with pane 2's seam fix rather than patching a second refresh path. Fix at the true layer, P4 pin (reset → data equals defaults → view reflects it), explicit paths, verify green, resolve the req. READY FOR USER TEST.
